title: DungeonBuddy NPC Registry v0.1
description: Per-campaign canonical lookup for known NPCs. GM-curated list of who exists, what their hub paths are, and when they last appeared. Lives at <campaign>/_npc_registry.json. Distinct from FactStore.entities (run-time extraction provenance) — the registry is campaign canon and survives across runs.

slug.description: Canonical lowercase-underscore identifier; must match an existing folder name under hub_path or setting_hub_path.

display_name.description: Human-facing name; usually derived from the hub README's `title:` frontmatter or H1.

aliases.description: Other names, epithets, or descriptors the NPC is referred to by. Populated initially from hub READMEs; grows as Stage D resolves descriptors against the registry.

status.description: tracked = has a hub README, GM-curated, regularly appears. background = has a hub README but minor/setting figure. dormant = was tracked but hasn't appeared in recent sessions (no removals, just status flag). candidate = appears in recaps but no hub yet; awaits GM curation.

first_session.description: First session this NPC appears in (or is referenced from). Sourced from timeline.md when present, else recap-derived.

last_session.description: Most recent session this NPC appeared in. Must be >= first_session. May lag behind reality if timeline.md is stale; see lint.

hub_path.description: Authoritative hub for this NPC in this campaign. Corpus-relative (i.e. relative to corpus/eldyrwild-markdown/), with trailing slash. Null is permitted ONLY for status=candidate (no hub exists yet).

setting_hub_path.description: When the same NPC also has a world/setting hub in Elderwyld, point to it; useful for cross-campaign lookup. Corpus-relative with trailing slash, or null.

notes.description: Human-readable caveats (e.g. timeline drift, twin-sharing-dossier quirks). Freely editable by GM.
